actions.desc: The echo demon summons horrible wails from the deep crevasses of the Abyss. Creatures within 60 feet who can hear the wails must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be stunned until the start of the echo demon's next turn. An affected creature continues hearing the troubling echoes of these cries until it finishes a long rest, and it has disadvantage on Intelligence checks until then.

actions.desc: The echo demon teleports up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space. Immediately after teleporting, it can make an iron claws attack with advantage as a bonus action.

actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) slashing damage and if the creature is wearing metal armor, it must make a successful DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be deafened until the end of its next turn.

traits.desc: The demon's presence is extremely distracting. Each creature within 100 feet of the echo demon and that can hear it has disadvantage on concentration checks.

ru.description: Среднее исчадие, мировоззрение: хаотично-злое. Класс доспеха: 15. Хиты: 102 (12к8+48). Скорость: ходьба 30 фт., полёт 20 фт.. Характеристики: СИЛ 20, ЛОВ 20, ТЕЛ 18, ИНТ 14, МУД 18, ХАР 16. Сопротивление урону: холодом, огнём, электричеством. Иммунитет к урону: ядом. Иммунитет к состояниям: отравление. Чувства: тёмное зрение 60 фт., пассивное Восприятие 14. Показатель опасности: 6. Структурированные механики записи: особенностей: 1, действий: 3.
